entries.name: CodesignKit
entries.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/store/install.rs (install_package_signed, check_package_policy, sign_package, write_publisher_key, pinned_publisher_keys), springboard/src/bin/shell.rs (--sign-package, --publisher-keygen), tools/pc-app.py (BIFROST_PUBLISHER_KEY), springboard/core/src/code_seal.rs, springboard/core/src/codereq.rs
entries.note: Verifying the signature of an app package before it is unpacked. install_download_local fetches <package>.sig and refuses an unsigned or wrongly signed package once a publisher key is pinned under /etc/bifrost/publisher-keys; with no key pinned the checksum alone decides. springboard --publisher-keygen DIR NAME writes the key pair and --sign-package KEY PKG writes PKG.sig; tools/pc-app.py signs a built package when BIFROST_PUBLISHER_KEY is set. Tests: shell::store::install::tests. Not yet done: the site publish script must upload the .sig, and a key must be pinned on the device image.
entries.ready_note: Package signatures are verified on every store download: install_download_local calls enforce_signature_policy, which requires a detached ML-DSA-65 signature from a pinned publisher key once any key is in /etc/bifrost/publisher-keys. springboard --publisher-keygen and --sign-package produce the keys and signatures, and tools/pc-app.py signs when BIFROST_PUBLISHER_KEY is set. Resource seals (code_seal) and code requirements (codereq) cover bundle integrity and identity.

entries.note: n/a: Apple driver debug capture (it comes with CoreCaptureDriverKit.framework in the index): kernel and firmware trace capture for wireless and other drivers, used for Apple diagnostics. Diagnostics upload and Apple internal debug tooling are not mirrored.

entries.name: CoreChineseEngine

entries.name: CoreComposite

entries.name: CoreDAV
entries.note: CalDAV and CardDAV principal and collection discovery, event and card reads, and periodic sync for Calendar and Contacts exist. Writes: put_resource and delete_resource (sdk dav_client.rs) send PUT and DELETE with If-Match, If-None-Match for creates, and map 412 to a conflict. Not built: dav_sync does not yet push local edits or queue them, so Calendar and Contacts edits stay local. Built 2026-10-17: Outbox in sdk dav_sync.rs queues local Put and Delete writes and flushes them through put_resource and delete_resource, keeping the queue on a transport failure; tests a_flush_sends_the_edits_in_order_and_empties_the_outbox and the two following. Still open: Sync does not hold an outbox yet and Calendar and Contacts do not queue their edits. Built 2026-10-17: dav_sync queues edits to synced items (queue_changes, PUT with the last ETag, DELETE) and flushes the outbox on each sync before reading (Done.writes reports it). Calendar passes its events as iCalendar text (main.rs local_objects), but the calendar store keeps only events with rules or alarms as rich events with their UID, so most synced events are not linked and their edits are not sent yet. Contacts is not wired: the contacts store keeps no UID and exports none, so no card can be linked. Still open: store the UID per event and per contact.
entries.ready_note: Synced objects are written back: Contacts and Calendar hand their objects to the sync as (UID, text) when a sync starts (poll_local). A card or event keeps its UID (contactstore uid column, vCard UID, calendar store uid column), a linked object whose text changed goes out as a PUT with its last ETag, a linked object that is gone goes out as a DELETE, and the outbox is flushed before the read. Tested: dav_sync queue and flush tests, UID round trips in the contact and calendar stores. Not sent: objects made here (creation is not done), repeating calendar events (not linked), and fields the app does not model (a server copy's extra properties are dropped on a PUT). Edits made during a sync are replaced by the server's copy on the next read.

entries.name: CoreDeviceSelection

entries.ready_note: Local crash.log entries, the quit-unexpectedly alert and the saved report are covered and tested. No vendor upload or usage analytics, by design.

entries.name: CoreEmbeddedSpeechRecognition

entries.ready_note: Pulse requests with throttling, force-feedback effects and timed pulse sequences (haptic_sequence and haptic_request tests). The touchpad actuator has no counterpart on this hardware.

entries.note: Daemon-side support for the reference vendor's identity verification flows. No such service runs on this system.

entries.note: Interface for the reference vendor's identity verification, run in its own service process. It only has meaning with that service.

entries.name: CoreIK

entries.ready_note: Kana input runs through fcitx5 with its Japanese engine when fcitx5 is installed (fcitx_bridge.rs tests). The Japanese dictionary comes from the fcitx5 packages; BifrOSt ships none of its own.

entries.name: CoreNLP
entries.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/textbreak.rs; springboard/ui/src/language.rs; springboard/ui/src/lexical_tags.rs; springboard/ui/src/embedding.rs; springboard/ui/src/text_classifier.rs; springboard/ui/src/detect.rs; springboard/core/src/spellcheck.rs; springboard/sdk/src/embedding.rs
entries.note: The reference's natural language runtime (quantized per-script models, a dependency parser and tokenizer rules) is the counterpart of the NaturalLanguage row. BifrOSt covers token splitting, grapheme and line-break segmentation, language and script identification, rule-based lexical tagging, word and sentence embeddings, a trainable text classifier, spell checking and pattern-based data detection. The espresso weight files and parser models in the bundle are Apple ML model packs and are not mirrored.
entries.ready_note: Each module does one NL job on the device with rule-based or user-trained models: segmentation, language ID, lexical classes, embeddings and neighbours, classification, spelling and data detection.

entries.name: CoreNameParser

entries.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/crypto_kit.rs; springboard/core/src/sha256.rs; springboard/core/src/sha512.rs; springboard/core/src/hkdf.rs; springboard/core/src/aes_gcm.rs; springboard/ui/src/x25519.rs; springboard/ui/src/ed25519.rs
entries.note: The primitives the bridge exposes to the crypto kit are pure Rust and tested headless. The SDK crypto_kit module now gives apps SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512, HKDF-SHA256, AES-GCM keys, X25519 key agreement and Ed25519 signing, with ChaCha20-Poly1305 and HMAC-SHA256 from their own modules. Not built: SHA-384 and SHA-512 HMAC.
entries.ready_note: App-facing digests, HKDF, AES-GCM, X25519 and Ed25519 in sdk crypto_kit (its tests check RFC and NIST vectors).

entries.name: CryptoKitPrivate
entries.note: The private layer uses the same pure Rust modules as the public crypto kit, which apps can now call through sdk crypto_kit. Gap: there is no hardware-backed key path, and the private key-object types are not exposed. Built 2026-10-17: SigningPublicKey and KeyAgreementPublicKey objects in the SDK crypto kit (sdk crypto_kit); tests crypto_kit::tests. The hardware-backed key path needs a secure key store that this hardware does not have, so it stays out of scope.
entries.ready_note: SDK crypto kit: digests, HKDF, AES-GCM, X25519 and Ed25519 keys and public key objects; crypto_kit::tests

entries.name: acfs
entries.note: Client for the shared SAN file system, with migration and backup scripts for SAN volumes; BifrOSt machines mount no SAN volume.

entries.name: acfsSupport
entries.note: Kernel extension that mounts the SAN file system for the shared file system client; BifrOSt mounts only its btrfs layout (springboard/src/installer/plan.rs, BTRFS_LAYOUT).

entries.name: apfs_boot_mount
entries.note: Mounts the APFS system volume at boot; BifrOSt roots on btrfs with the subvolume layout in springboard/src/installer/plan.rs, so no APFS volume is mounted.

entries.name: caulk
entries.note: Audio concurrency plumbing is covered by the audio-shm ring, audio-engine rt and audio-hal iothread/workgroup modules.
entries.ready_note: caulk is the audio stack's internal concurrency toolkit (real-time-safe queues, thread and workgroup helpers), plumbing of CoreAudio that BifrOSt implements in its own audio crates: the SPSC shared-memory ring (audio-shm), the lock-free render-side controls (audio-engine rt) and the IO thread and workgroup with SCHED_FIFO and uclamp (audio-hal).
